updates.change: Winglet added to the halo pillar
updates.how: Introducing a winglet element to the halo pillar as a minor update. Not event specific, it simply returns a small aerodynamic load benefit

updates.change: Profile modification to brake duct winglets.
updates.how: The winglet geometry change helps improve the flow management at the back of the car and around the rear tyre.

updates.change: Small winglet placed on top of the Rear Impact Structure
updates.how: The winglet is shaped to promote upwash, which in turn improves the local aerodynamic characteristics and results in a corresponding increase in load.

updates.change: Updated front wing flap and end plate geometry
updates.how: The new flap and end plate lead to improved flow characteristics travelling further downstream along the car – locally and globally more efficient.
In combination with the above mentioned step, the updated nose design allows a more efficient load extraction all along the slope.

updates.change: Trailing edge detail changes on diffuser winglet cascade
updates.how: Modifications made to the trailing edge lead to an increase in the local aerodynamic load acting on the winglet cascade, consequently increasing the overall aerodynamic load at the rear of the car.
Aerodynamic surface geometry has been revised in order to accommodate and integrate the latest structural improvements made to the component.
